goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Implemented hold-physical-KeyM marquee activation with frozen Shift additivity, strict arming guards, complete disarm/cancellation lifecycle, and preserved Space/middle pan precedence. Unarmed short background presses clear selection; drags at or above 4px are inert and suppress successor clicks. Marquee now selects visible leaf-most descendants within the frozen scope, normalizes full additive unions against ancestor coexistence, preserves DOM order and one primary handle, and keeps cross-parent operations gated. Updated cursor guidance and README. Targeted verification passed 176 tests; full check passed 376 tests, typecheck, and build.
